name: Ultegra Di2 front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 2014–2015 reference for the ten-speed Di2 FD-6770-F braze-on front derailleur, without a clamp adapter. The later 2017–2018 table lists 160 g with its fixing bolt.
